landing.heroLead: The Kingdom as it really is,
landing.heroBold: through a lens that knows the place.
landing.heroBody: Saudi video albums, edit-ready — buy the album once and own its licence forever, with no subscription.
landing.storyBody: Laqta started from a simple frustration: every campaign about Saudi Arabia ends up searching global libraries that cannot tell one district from another — selling Dubai as Riyadh and the Moroccan desert as Najd. We decided to build the alternative: a library indexed by people who know the location, the season and the light.
landing.solution1Body: Every shot is Saudi, indexed under the place names locals actually use — not machine translations.
landing.solution2Body: Every album is reviewed before it is published, and the result appears on the album page.
landing.solution3Body: Buy the album once and own its licence forever, with a compliant tax invoice — no subscription that lapses at the end of the month.
landing.problemTitle: Why global libraries don't cut it
landing.problemBody: Search “Saudi Arabia” in any global library and you get Dubai, a skyline five years out of date, and scenes shot somewhere else and labelled with the Kingdom's name. Your audience notices before your client does.
landing.problemPoint1Body: Dubai towers sold as Riyadh, the Moroccan desert sold as Najd.
landing.problemPoint2Body: Riyadh's skyline has changed enormously in five years. Most global archives have not changed with it.
landing.problemPoint3Body: Dress, architecture and daily detail that look nothing like the Kingdom — a campaign loses its credibility instantly.
landing.problemPoint4Body: Footage of locations that cannot be filmed commercially without permission, sold with no proof of any.
landing.audienceLead: If your work is about Saudi Arabia,
landing.audience1Body: Campaigns for Saudi brands, with material you never have to apologise for.
landing.audience2Body: Tax invoice, purchase order, bank transfer, and documented clearance on every shot.
landing.audience3Body: A ready library that saves you a full shoot day per campaign.
landing.audience4Body: Connecting shots and establishers at cinematic quality with consistent specs.
landing.locationsSubtitle: From Riyadh to the Empty Quarter
landing.categoriesSubtitle: Aerial, heritage, business, nature and more
landing.creatorsSubtitle: They know the location, the season and the light
landing.howStep1Body: Search in Arabic or English, and filter by location, resolution, aspect ratio and clearance.
landing.howStep2Body: A clip is sold inside its album. Pay once and get every clip in it.
landing.howStep3Body: Instant download at original resolution, a permanent licence, and a compliant tax invoice.
landing.positioning: No subscriptions. Buy once, own it forever.
landing.clearanceBody: AlUla, Diriyah, NEOM, the Red Sea and airports each have their own permitting authority, and commercial filming without a permit is a violation. Every album on Laqta is reviewed before publication, and the result appears on the album page.
landing.sellBody: Publish your albums and keep the larger share of every sale. Review within three business days, and monthly transfers by bank, Wise or Payoneer.
landing.notifyBody: Leave your email and we'll write the moment the library opens.
landing.notifyThanks: Done — we'll be in touch at launch.
landing.wallHint: Tap any clip to open its album
landing.collectionBody: Coherent sets on a single subject with matching specs. Watch the trailer, buy the whole album.
landing.testimonialQuote: “Finally, Saudi footage we don't have to apologise for. We bought the album in the morning and it was on the timeline before the end of the day.”
landing.licenseBody: Every album is sold under a permanent commercial licence: buy once, and use the footage in your campaigns and client work forever. Every album is reviewed before publication, so what reaches you is ready to broadcast.
landing.lic1Body: Use the footage in advertising, campaigns and commercial content, with no cap on views.
landing.lic2Body: Every album goes through review before it is listed, and the result appears on its page.
landing.lic3Body: Native resolution up to 4K, with consistent specs that drop straight onto a timeline.
landing.lic4Title: Permanent ownership and a compliant invoice
landing.lic4Body: You own what you bought, forever, with a compliant tax invoice for every purchase.
landing.faq1Q: Do I buy one clip or the whole album?
landing.faq1A: Clips are sold inside their albums. You buy the album once and get every clip in it at native resolution — no subscription.
landing.faq2A: A permanent commercial licence covering campaigns, advertising and commercial content, with no cap on views or on how long you use it.
landing.faq3Q: What resolution and format are the clips?
landing.faq3A: Clips are delivered at 1080p, and some albums at 4K. The format is MP4/H.264, and the technical specs are shown on every clip page.
landing.faq4A: Yes, and we say so plainly. It is why we can reach any location in any season at any hour, and it is why the price is what it is.
landing.faq5Q: How do I get my clips and my invoice?
landing.faq5A: Instant download at native resolution after payment, with a compliant tax invoice sent straight to you — and your purchases stay in your library permanently.
landing.offersHint: The struck-through figure is the usual price. You pay the smaller one, and own the album forever.

sell.title: Sell your footage on Laqta
sell.boldLead: and the footage is asleep on a hard drive.
sell.intro: Laqta is a Saudi footage library. If you have Saudi material — filmed or generated — this is the fastest way to turn it into recurring income without giving up your rights.
sell.shareHint: It rises automatically with your total sales. No negotiation, no annual contracts.
sell.whatWeNeed1: Saudi footage, filmed or generated — provided it is disclosed.
sell.whatWeNeed2: Coherent albums of at least 8 clips, at one frame rate and one colour profile.
sell.whatWeNeed3: Complete clearance: a model release for every identifiable face, and a filming permit wherever the location requires one.
sell.whatWeNeed4: Full rights to the material — nothing lifted, nothing produced by someone else.
sell.how1Body: Gather your clips into a coherent album, attach the clearances, and pick the tier. Price follows the clip count — no price negotiation and no undercutting.
sell.how2Title: We review it within 3 business days
sell.how2Body: A human reviewer checks that the specs match, the clearances are complete, the material is culturally sound, and it doesn't duplicate the catalogue. If something needs changing you get a specific note, not a blank rejection.
sell.how3Title: It goes live and starts selling
sell.how3Body: Track views, sales and revenue in your own studio, and see what buyers searched for and didn't find — a ready-made shot list.
sell.how4Body: Earnings from each sale are held for 30 days until the refund window closes, then become withdrawable by bank transfer, Payoneer or Wise.
sell.keepBody: The licence is non-exclusive by default: your material stays yours, and you are free to list it elsewhere. Exclusivity is a choice that adds five points to your share, not a condition of entry.
sell.frozenTitle: Your rate is frozen at the moment of sale
sell.frozenBody: If your tier rises later, your share on earlier sales does not change — and nothing is clawed back. What sold at a rate stays counted at that rate.
sell.faq1Q: Do I need a commercial registration?
sell.faq1A: No. Individuals and businesses are both accepted. What we need is correct transfer details and a tax declaration of your tax residency.
sell.faq2Q: Can I sell from outside Saudi Arabia?
sell.faq2A: Yes, as long as the footage is Saudi and the rights are clean. Transfers go through Payoneer or Wise.
sell.faq3A: The tier sets it, by clip count, so the catalogue keeps one price per album size and nobody has to compete on price.
sell.faq4Q: What if my album is rejected?
sell.faq4A: You get a specific note on what needs changing, and the album returns to you editable and resubmittable. Final rejection is rare and reserved for rights violations.
